Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Use a Maneuver to reduce temporary Burning by 2 or put out an adjacent hand-sized flame.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
Ten minutes.
Target / range / shape
One course of action you describe.
Type
Magic / Utility

Describe a course of action your party could begin during the next hour and make a Reason roll. The DA answers from the present situation.

Weak
Learn one concrete danger on that course.
Standard
Also learn an available way to avoid or lessen it.
Strong
Also learn a recognizable sign that will warn you before that danger strikes.
